problems.title: Sum of Two Numbers
problems.description: Read two integers from standard input and print their arithmetic sum.
problems.inputFormat: Two space-separated integers A and B on a single line.
problems.outputFormat: Print the integer sum of A and B.

problems.title: Simple Interest Calculator
problems.description: Given principal P, annual interest rate R (in percent), and time T (in years), compute the Simple Interest rounded to 2 decimal places.
problems.inputFormat: Three space-separated numbers: P (double), R (double), T (double).
problems.outputFormat: Print the simple interest formatted with 2 decimal places (e.g. 150.00).

problems.title: Check Leap Year
problems.description: Determine whether a given year Y is a leap year according to the Gregorian calendar rules. A year is leap if it is divisible by 4, except century years which must be divisible by 400.
problems.inputFormat: A single positive integer Y representing the year.
problems.outputFormat: Print "Leap Year" if it is a leap year, otherwise print "Not a Leap Year".

problems.title: Greatest of Three Numbers
problems.description: Given three distinct integers A, B, and C, find and output the largest value among them.
problems.inputFormat: Three space-separated integers A, B, and C.

problems.title: Check Prime Number
problems.description: Given an integer N, determine if it is a prime number. A prime number is greater than 1 and has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.
problems.inputFormat: A single integer N.
problems.outputFormat: Print "Prime" if N is prime, otherwise print "Not Prime".

problems.title: Reverse a Number
problems.description: Given a non-negative integer N, reverse its digits. Leading zeros in the reversed number should be eliminated (e.g. 120 -> 21).
problems.inputFormat: A single non-negative integer N.

problems.title: Fibonacci Series up to N
problems.description: Print the first N terms of the Fibonacci sequence starting from 0 and 1. Terms must be space-separated.
problems.inputFormat: A single positive integer N.
problems.outputFormat: Print the first N terms separated by a single space.

problems.title: Find Second Largest in Array
problems.description: Given an array of N integers, find the second largest distinct element. If no second largest distinct element exists, print -1.
problems.inputFormat: First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
problems.outputFormat: Print the second largest distinct integer or -1.

problems.title: Palindrome String Check
problems.description: Check whether a given string is a palindrome (ignoring casing and whitespace).
problems.inputFormat: A string S on a single line.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.description: Given a string containing just the characters "(", ")", "{", "}", "[" and "]", determine if the input string is valid. Brackets must close in the correct order with matching open bracket types.
problems.inputFormat: A single string S containing bracket symbols.

problems.title: Odd or Even in C
problems.description: Given an integer N, print "Even" if the number is even and "Odd" if the number is odd.
problems.inputFormat: A single integer N.

problems.title: Quadrant of a Point
problems.description: Given 2D coordinates (X, Y), determine the quadrant: "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Origin", or "Axis".
problems.inputFormat: Two space-separated integers X and Y.

problems.title: Factorial of a Number
problems.description: Compute the factorial N! for a non-negative integer N.
problems.inputFormat: Single non-negative integer N.

problems.title: Array Elements Inversion Count
problems.description: Given an array of N integers, reverse the array in-place and print the reversed elements separated by spaces.
problems.inputFormat: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
problems.outputFormat: N reversed integers separated by space.

problems.title: Binary Search Implementation
problems.description: Given a sorted array of N integers and a target key K, find the 0-based index of K. If not present, print -1.
problems.inputFormat: Line 1: N and K. Line 2: N sorted space-separated integers.

problems.title: Temperature Converter (C to F)
problems.description: Convert a temperature given in Celsius C to Fahrenheit F: F = (C * 9/5) + 32. Print result rounded to 1 decimal place.
problems.inputFormat: Single floating point number C.
problems.outputFormat: Print temperature in Fahrenheit with 1 decimal place (e.g. 98.6).

problems.title: Triangle Type Classifier
problems.description: Given three side lengths A, B, and C, classify whether they form an: "Equilateral", "Isosceles", "Scalene", or "Invalid" triangle.
problems.inputFormat: Three space-separated integers A, B, and C.

problems.title: Armstrong Number Check
problems.description: An Armstrong number of k digits is an integer such that the sum of its digits raised to the power k equals the number itself. Determine if N is an Armstrong number.
problems.inputFormat: A positive integer N.

problems.title: Sort and Count Inversions using STL
problems.description: Given N integers, sort them in ascending order and print them on one line separated by spaces.
problems.inputFormat: Line 1: N. Line 2: N space-separated integers.

problems.title: Two Sum Target Search
problems.description: Given an array of N integers and a target sum T, determine whether there exist two distinct indices whose elements sum to T.
problems.inputFormat: Line 1: N and T. Line 2: N space-separated integers.
problems.outputFormat: Print "YES" if such a pair exists, otherwise "NO".

problems.title: Formatted Greeting & Length
problems.description: Given a person's name, print "Hello, {name}!" on line 1, and the length of the name on line 2.
problems.inputFormat: A string representing the name.
problems.outputFormat:
Line 1: Hello, <name>!
Line 2: Character length of the name.

problems.title: Electricity Bill Calculator
problems.description:
Calculate electricity charges based on units consumed:
- First 100 units: $1.50 per unit
- Next 100 units (101-200): $2.50 per unit
- Above 200 units: $3.50 per unit
Print total bill with 2 decimal places.
problems.inputFormat: A non-negative integer representing units.

problems.title: Sum of Digits in Python
problems.description: Given an integer N, find the sum of its digits.
problems.inputFormat: An integer N.

starterCode.python:
n = input().strip()
total = sum(int(ch) for ch in n if ch.isdigit())
print(total)

problems.title: Word Frequency Counter
problems.description: Given a space-separated sentence, count the frequency of each unique lowercase word. Print words sorted alphabetically with their count formatted as "word: count".
problems.inputFormat: A sentence on a single line.
problems.outputFormat: Each unique word and count on its own line: "<word>: <count>".
problems.exampleInput: apple banana apple orange banana apple

testCases.input: apple banana apple orange banana apple

problems.title: Check Anagram Strings
problems.description: Given two strings S1 and S2 on separate lines, determine whether they are anagrams of each other (contain the same characters with identical frequencies, case-sensitive).
problems.inputFormat:
Line 1: S1
Line 2: S2

problems.title: Print Prime Numbers in a Given Range
problems.description:
Write a program to print all prime numbers between two given numbers.
A prime number is a number greater than 1 that has exactly two factors: 1 and itself.
Print the prime numbers in ascending order.
problems.inputFormat: Single line with test inputs.The input contains two integers L and R, representing the starting and ending values of the range.
problems.outputFormat: Output formPrint all prime numbers between L and R, separated by spaces.at description.
